purpose: Narrow intermittent startup resets after c6ca bounded PM and bus-clock candidates

clock_parent_trace: Failed startup captured without any clk_set_parent event. Does not establish a parent-assignment fault.
IOMMU_graph_trace: SCM restore calls return; no qcom_iommu_fault entry captured before reset. Absence from a USB stream does not exclude later execution.

IOMMU_instruction_probes.successful_run: Starts, five-second off/on completes, all four devices auto/suspended while off.
IOMMU_instruction_probes.failed_repeat: Instrumented clock enable, SCM restore and all 18 BFB writes complete; context loop reaches return0 before later MDSS power transitions.
IOMMU_instruction_probes.limitation: No exact reset instruction established by those probes.

bounded_PHY_probe_reference.change: Hold PHY runtime reference across PLL clock and provider registration; balanced success/error puts.
bounded_PHY_probe_reference.build: Exact44 external MSM W=1 passes. Private experimental module.
bounded_PHY_probe_reference.first_start_and_cycle: Pass, all four devices suspended during five-second off. No owner physical confirmation for this particular candidate.
bounded_PHY_probe_reference.repeat_start: Reset; sequence stopped, retained logs captured.
bounded_PHY_probe_reference.conclusion: Not sufficient; not promoted or installed.

diagnostic_kernel.result: Reset during candidate startup; full raw retained RAM decoded successfully.

persistent_trace_result.result: Startup reset; full raw 512KiB ramoops captured before next boot, decoded as diagnostic layout.
persistent_trace_result.trace: Per-CPU retained function records continue after clock-enable calls from the DSI version-query path. Call-return offsets match optional bus and iface prepare/enable pairs in exact MSM binary.
persistent_trace_result.module_base: Inferred consistently from four matching caller offsets; no claim of direct .text sysfs capture in this run.
persistent_trace_result.inference: Next source path is DSI_VERSION MMIO. Test missing normal bus clocks before changing locking behavior. A final function-call record alone does not prove the exact faulting instruction.
persistent_trace_result.lockup_detectors: No retained soft-lockup or hung-task report. Does not prove neither condition occurred.
persistent_trace_result.taint: External diagnostic MSM marked out-of-tree; native packaged module test remains taint0.

next_candidate: Validate a temporary initial-power-hold wrapper in a RAM boot of native Nura; continue investigating the first DSI version read separately.
persistent_device_writes: None in these experiments; root ro,noload. No eMMC/GPT or calibration writes.

results: First startup and five-second cycle pass after waiting for pattern owner readiness; initial test-helper pidfd_getfd call was premature.
Second startup and five-second cycle pass.
Third startup resets; retained logs captured; no fourth run.
optional_core_mmss_query_clock.qualification: Insufficient. No owner visual pass for these particular runs. Private prototype; no upstream fix claimed.

complete_optional_query_bus_set.build: W=1 passes with balanced temporary handles
complete_optional_query_bus_set.result: First startup resets during early child creation; retained logs captured; no repeat runs.

unfiltered_persistent_trace.result: Second diagnostic boot resets; raw per-CPU rings decode successfully.
unfiltered_persistent_trace.MSM_text_base: Captured directly from module sysfs before failure; symbol offsets match exact diagnostic module. Actual addresses kept private.
unfiltered_persistent_trace.last_probing_CPU_path: msm_dsi_host_init -> query bus clock prepare/enable -> iface prepare/enable. Last recorded callback returns through clk_enable unlock and preemption-count update; next inlined source path reads DSI version registers.
unfiltered_persistent_trace.other_CPUs: Two recorded idle paths; another was performing ordinary page-table/highmem work.
unfiltered_persistent_trace.limitation: This does not identify which of the three possible version reads stalls, or prove the faulting instruction. A separate private diagnostic adds distinct noinline wrappers for those existing reads.
unfiltered_persistent_trace.trace_overhead: Unfiltered recording has high overhead and also records persistent-buffer helper calls; do not treat timings as normal runtime.

escape_clock_candidate.change: Add optional core/escape clock during version query along with other query bus clocks.
escape_clock_candidate.verified_so_far: Three startups and three five-second cycles pass; fourth startup resets. Escape clock alone is not a sufficient fix.
escape_clock_candidate.qualification: Not sufficient; no source/package promoted. No candidate-specific owner visual pass.

read_site_diagnostic.result: First startup fails and returns to fastboot. Raw custom-layout ramoops captured and decoded.
trace_sequence: DSI iface clock enable returns through unlock/preemption update
dsi_version_read_initial entry: existing read at controller base+0x1f0
Immediate next recorded entry do_DataAbort from ARM exception path
Error reporting follows printk console flush into framebuffer drawing
read_site_diagnostic.inference: The first unshifted version read or its post-read barrier raises an ARM data abort. Full fault-status/address/PC report is not yet retained.
read_site_diagnostic.log_capture_change: Detach the inherited framebuffer VT console before probing, leaving its driver and scanout alone, so the error report can reach pstore without framebuffer rendering.
read_site_diagnostic.console_detached_runs: Two starts succeed; third fails. Only-ramoops-console variant passes once and fails once. No full fault report retained.

console_detached_result: Two startups succeed; third resets with retained trace again ending at initial read. No complete ARM fault report. UART remained a kernel console in these runs.

image.change: Remove early/serial/VT kernel console parameters; select ramoops only. Separate helper detaches inherited framebuffer VT driver before probing.

pstore_only_kernel_console.verification: /proc/consoles contains ramoops only; inherited VT framebuffer driver detached before module load.
pstore_only_kernel_console.result: First startup succeeds; second resets at initial read, still without complete fault report. Raw captured and decoded.

read_only_power_snapshot.build: Exact pmdebug1 ABI, W=1 passes; reads only six documented MMCC power/clock registers, reports runtime PM counters before first version read.
read_only_power_snapshot.results: Five startups complete. No failure yet for comparison; no owner physical confirmation specific to these runs.
read_only_power_snapshot.successful_variation: MDP CBCR can be00006ff1 or80006ff0; ESC CBCR can be00000001 or80000000. MDP/escape can be gated when the version read succeeds.
read_only_power_snapshot.limits: Snapshot adds ioremap, MMCC reads, printk, iounmap and a write barrier. Five successes do not identify which effect changes the race or prove reliable startup.

USB_transport_recovery.observation: Normal software reboot can enumerate selected lk2nd but getvar product times out.
USB_transport_recovery.verified_recovery: USBDEVFS_RESET on exactly the selected physical USB port, VID/PID and private serial restored getvar product immediately without a phone reset.
USB_transport_recovery.scope: Transport recovery only; no flash/eMMC write. Local closure helpers try this once after bounded failed reads and revalidate lk2nd product before staged log retrieval. Final bootloader/host reliability still open.
